description.en: Control NAD A/V receivers and amplifiers. Supports classic T-Series (Telnet), D-Series (TCP) and RS-232 models, plus BluOS streaming models (M10, M33, C700, C658) with volume, source, transport controls and media browsing.

value.en: This integration communicates with NAD A/V receivers and amplifiers over the network (Telnet / TCP / BluOS) or serial (RS-232) to provide control of your audio system. Enter your device details on the next screen.
